name: OptiObra Frontend
author: OptiObra Team
description: Frontend Angular servido por nginx con soporte de tuneles de Cloudflare (cloudflared). Se expone via tunnel sin abrir puertos.

config.startup: {"done": "OptiObra frontend is up and running", "nginx": "start worker processes"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OptiObra Frontend Installation Script

# Create directories
mkdir -p /home/container/logs

# Set permissions
chown -R 1000:1000 /home/container/logs

echo "Installation completed."

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token del tunel de Cloudflare (cloudflared). Dejalo vacio para deshabilitar el tunel. Configura el ingress en el panel de Cloudflare apuntando a http://localhost.
